metadata.key_test: Continental-scale P1 ordinality with Mod4 margin gating. India's lead (gap ~0.92-0.98 WGI points) is well above the WGI margin of error -> strong ordinal. But the Bangladesh (-0.96) vs Pakistan (-1.02) gap = 0.06 is WITHIN the margin -> LIVE correctly DEFERS the sub-ranking to Safeguard B rather than asserting a false Bangladesh>Pakistan ordinal (STATIC over-claims). Safeguard C (Bangladesh August-2024 collapse) carries forward.
metadata.notes: WGI Rule of Law figures on the native -2.5/+2.5 scale (NOT 0-100 .SC). 2024 endpoints India -0.04, Pakistan -1.02, Bangladesh -0.96 are high-confidence verbatim; intermediate-year values (2004/2012/2018) could not be retrieved verbatim and P1 normalizations are estimates anchored to 2024 endpoints. Case PARTIALLY CONFIRMED: India ordinal confirmed; Bangladesh/Pakistan sub-ordinal deferred (LIVE) / over-claimed (STATIC). Bangladesh GDP series suspect (interim-government white paper found Hasina-era GDP inflated ~$100B).

a_trajectory_ranking.prediction: Three-way ordinal India > Bangladesh ~ Pakistan. India lead asserted strongly; Bangladesh/Pakistan sub-ordinal DEFERRED under LIVE Mod4 (would be over-claimed under STATIC).
a_trajectory_ranking.basis: India gap ~0.92-0.98 WGI points >> margin of error; Bangladesh-Pakistan gap 0.06 < margin -> defer to Safeguard B.
a_trajectory_ranking.falsification_condition: Pakistan or Bangladesh outperforms India, or a clear stable Bangladesh>Pakistan / Pakistan>Bangladesh ordinal emerges within the gap.

b_violence.prediction: India sub-state turbulent but union-stable; Pakistan chronically unstable; Bangladesh episodic-to-acute.
b_violence.agency_note: Mod8: this predicts RISK, not AGENCY
b_violence.falsification_condition: India union destabilizes, or Pakistan/Bangladesh prove stable.

c_convergence.prediction: India pulls away (1996-2024); Bangladesh and Pakistan converge near the floor.
c_convergence.basis: Widening India lead vs. floor-clustered Bangladesh/Pakistan.
c_convergence.falsification_condition: India converges toward the others or the floor pair diverges sharply.

d_failure_dimension.prediction: N/A - no single-failure-dimension prediction scored separately in the run.

f_reversal_risk.prediction: Bangladesh reversal (Safeguard C: growth-without-institutions) - carry forward. India backsliding predicted as electoral-turnover risk over authoritarian reversal (Mod12: founding-P1 LOW, so no shield).
f_reversal_risk.falsification_condition: Bangladesh avoids reversal, or India entrenches full authoritarian reversal despite formal elections.

g_suppression_mechanism.classification: India porosity = Tier 3 (porosity present, strong-center President's-Rule backstop). Mod9 partial re-suppression (Article 370 revocation 2019, CAA, ED actions) is a WATCH flag, not a trigger.
g_suppression_mechanism.falsification_condition: India undergoes full re-suppression of porosity (federal collapse / authoritarian entrenchment).

h_substate_turbulence.prediction: India sub-state turbulence (Kashmir, NE India, Maoist belt, communal violence) tolerated while union holds.
h_substate_turbulence.falsification_condition: Sub-state turbulence propagates to union-level breakdown, or India is sub-state-quiescent.

India.outcome_summary: Union-stable, sub-state turbulent; 2024 Lok Sabha showed electoral turnover not authoritarian reversal. WGI RoL -0.04 (clear regional lead).
key_events: 2024 Lok Sabha: 642M voters; BJP fell to 240 seats (from 303 in 2019), lost single-party majority; INDIA coalition won 234
Supreme Court struck down electoral-bonds scheme against government opposition
J&K fatalities fell 4,011 (2001) -> 127 (2024) per South Asia Terrorism Portal; Maoist belt declining

Pakistan.outcome_summary: Chronically unstable; floor-clustered (WGI RoL -1.02, CPI 27). Sub-ordinal vs Bangladesh deferred under Mod4.

Bangladesh.outcome_summary: August-2024 authoritarian collapse (Safeguard C confirmed); floor-clustered (WGI RoL -0.96, CPI 23). Growth-without-institutional-delivery.
key_events: UN OHCHR (12 Feb 2025): as many as 1,400 people could have been killed during the protests, the vast majority by military rifles and shotguns loaded with lethal metal pellets
Yunus interim-government white paper: Hasina-era GDP inflated ~$100B

result_coding_reference.CONFIRMED: Prediction matched outcome on the specific dimension predicted
result_coding_reference.PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED: Direction correct but magnitude, form, or timing significantly different
result_coding_reference.NOT_APPLICABLE: Prediction type not relevant to this case
result_coding_reference.coding_rule: When ambiguous between confirmed and partial, code PARTIAL. When ambiguous between partial and falsified, code PARTIAL but note ambiguity.

analysis.overall_assessment: PARTIALLY CONFIRMED: India ordinal CONFIRMED; Bangladesh/Pakistan sub-ordinal correctly DEFERRED under LIVE (over-claimed under STATIC). LIVE materially better - Mod4 prevents a false sub-ordinal; Mod12 correctly denies India founding-P1 protection; Safeguard I structures the India porosity (Tier 3) classification.

analysis.what_this_case_uniquely_reveals: Continental-scale P1 ordinality with margin gating: the world's largest complexity-capacity experiment (India) holds at the union level while tolerating high sub-state turbulence, and the framework refuses to assert ordinals across sub-margin gaps. Mod4 is the single clearest LIVE-over-STATIC improvement in the run.
